# shadcn/ui Component API Documentation

**Feature**: 005-comprehensive-css-class  
**Component Library**: shadcn/ui

---

## Overview

This document defines how shadcn/ui components are used in Solar Match, including customization guidelines, variants, and styling contracts.

---

## Installation & Setup

### shadcn CLI Configuration

```json
// components.json (generated by shadcn init)
{
  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema.json",
  "style": "default",
  "rsc": true,
  "tsx": true,
  "tailwind": {
    "config": "tailwind.config.js",
    "css": "src/app/globals.css",
    "baseColor": "slate",
    "cssVariables": true, // ✅ Use CSS variables for theming
    "prefix": "" // No prefix for className utilities
  },
  "aliases": {
    "components": "@/components",
    "utils": "@/lib/utils",
    "ui": "@/components/ui",
    "lib": "@/lib",
    "hooks": "@/hooks"
  }
}
```

## Component Contracts

### 1. Button Component

**File**: `src/components/ui/button.tsx`

**Installation**:
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add button
```

**API**:
```typescript
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

interface ButtonProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: "default" | "destructive" | "outline" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "link";
  size?: "default" | "sm" | "lg" | "icon";
  asChild?: boolean; // Use Slot from Radix for polymorphism
}
```

**Variants**:
```tsx
// Primary button (default)
<Button variant="default">Submit</Button>
// className: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90

// Destructive button
<Button variant="destructive">Delete</Button>
// className: bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90

// Outline button
<Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
// className: border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground

// Secondary button
<Button variant="secondary">Save Draft</Button>
// className: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80

// Ghost button (no background)
<Button variant="ghost">Skip</Button>
// className: hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground

// Link button
<Button variant="link">Learn More</Button>
// className: text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline
```

**Sizes**:
```tsx
<Button size="sm">Small</Button>     // h-9 px-3 text-sm
<Button size="default">Default</Button> // h-10 px-4 py-2
<Button size="lg">Large</Button>     // h-11 px-8 text-lg
<Button size="icon"><Icon /></Button> // h-10 w-10 (square)
```

**Customization Rules**:
- ✅ **Allowed**: Add custom icons, loading states, disabled states
- ❌ **Forbidden**: Override `bg-*`, `text-*`, `border-*` classes directly
- ✅ **Proper Way**: Extend variants in `button.tsx` using `cva()` utility

**Example Custom Variant**:
```typescript
// src/components/ui/button.tsx
import { cva } from "class-variance-authority";

const buttonVariants = cva(
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm font-medium...",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90",
        // ... existing variants ...
        solar: "bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-600 to-blue-600 text-white", // Custom Solar Match variant
      },
      // ... rest of variants ...
    }
  }
);
```

### 2. Card Component

**File**: `src/components/ui/card.tsx`

**Installation**:
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add card
```

**API**:
```typescript
import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter } from "@/components/ui/card";

// Sub-components (composition pattern)
<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle>Title</CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>Description</CardDescription>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent>Content</CardContent>
  <CardFooter>Footer</CardFooter>
</Card>
```

**Default Styles**:
- `Card`: `rounded-lg border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm`
- `CardHeader`: `flex flex-col space-y-1.5 p-6`
- `CardTitle`: `text-2xl font-semibold leading-none tracking-tight`
- `CardDescription`: `text-sm text-muted-foreground`
- `CardContent`: `p-6 pt-0`
- `CardFooter`: `flex items-center p-6 pt-0`

**Customization Rules**:
- ✅ **Allowed**: Add custom padding, max-width, hover effects
- ❌ **Forbidden**: Replace `bg-card` with hardcoded colors (e.g., `bg-white`)
- ✅ **Proper Way**: Use semantic color tokens from CSS variables

**Example with Custom Styling**:
```tsx
<Card className="max-w-md hover:shadow-lg transition-shadow duration-200">
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle>Solar Quote</CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>Estimated savings for your home</CardDescription>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent>
    <p className="text-heading-2 text-primary">$25,000</p>
    <p className="text-body-small text-muted-foreground">Over 20 years</p>
  </CardContent>
  <CardFooter>
    <Button>Get Quote</Button>
  </CardFooter>
</Card>
```

---

### 3. Input Component

**File**: `src/components/ui/input.tsx`

**Installation**:
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add input
```

**API**:
```typescript
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

interface InputProps extends React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> {}
```

**Default Styles**:
```
flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm 
ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium 
file:text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none 
focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 
disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50
```

**Usage with Label**:
```tsx
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";

<div className="grid w-full max-w-sm items-center gap-1.5">
  <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
  <Input type="email" id="email" placeholder="Email" />
</div>
```

**Customization Rules**:
- ✅ **Allowed**: Add input masks, validation states
- ❌ **Forbidden**: Remove focus ring (`focus-visible:ring-2`)
- ✅ **Proper Way**: Extend with custom validation styling

**Example with Error State**:
```tsx
<div>
  <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
  <Input 
    type="email" 
    id="email" 
    placeholder="Email" 
    className={errors.email ? "border-destructive" : ""}
  />
  {errors.email && (
    <p className="text-sm text-destructive mt-1">{errors.email.message}</p>
  )}
</div>
```

### 4. Select Component

**File**: `src/components/ui/select.tsx`

**Installation**:
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add select
```

**API**:
```typescript
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";

<Select>
  <SelectTrigger className="w-[180px]">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Select a state" />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="ca">California</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="tx">Texas</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="fl">Florida</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
```

**Customization Rules**:
- ✅ **Allowed**: Add search functionality, custom rendering
- ❌ **Forbidden**: Replace with `react-select` without justification (see exceptions.json)
- ✅ **Proper Way**: Use shadcn Select unless multi-select/async needed

### 5. Modal (Dialog) Component

**File**: `src/components/ui/dialog.tsx`

**Installation**:
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add dialog
```

**API**:
```typescript
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger } from "@/components/ui/dialog";

<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger asChild>
    <Button variant="outline">Edit Profile</Button>
  </DialogTrigger>
  <DialogContent>
    <DialogHeader>
      <DialogTitle>Edit profile</DialogTitle>
      <DialogDescription>
        Make changes to your profile here. Click save when you're done.
      </DialogDescription>
    </DialogHeader>
    {/* Form content */}
  </DialogContent>
</Dialog>
```

**Customization Rules**:
- ✅ **Allowed**: Custom animations, max-width, backdrop blur
- ❌ **Forbidden**: Remove backdrop overlay (`data-[state=open]:animate-in`)
- ✅ **Proper Way**: Use Radix Dialog primitives for custom behavior

### 8. Form Component

**File**: `src/components/ui/form.tsx`

**Installation**:
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add form
```

**API** (with React Hook Form):
```typescript
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { Form, FormControl, FormDescription, FormField, FormItem, FormLabel, FormMessage } from "@/components/ui/form";

const form = useForm();

<Form {...form}>
  <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
    <FormField
      control={form.control}
      name="username"
      render={({ field }) => (
        <FormItem>
          <FormLabel>Username</FormLabel>
          <FormControl>
            <Input placeholder="shadcn" {...field} />
          </FormControl>
          <FormDescription>
            This is your public display name.
          </FormDescription>
          <FormMessage />
        </FormItem>
      )}
    />
  </form>
</Form>
```

## Icon Integration

### lucide-react Icons

Replace `@heroicons/react` with `lucide-react` (FR-039):

```tsx
// ❌ Old (Heroicons)
import { CheckIcon, XMarkIcon } from "@heroicons/react/24/outline";

// ✅ New (lucide-react)
import { Check, X } from "lucide-react";

<Check className="icon-sm" /> // 16px
<X className="icon-md" /> // 20px
```

**Icon Sizing Classes** (from icon-sizes.json):
- `icon-xs`: `h-3 w-3` (12px) - Badge icons
- `icon-sm`: `h-4 w-4` (16px) - Button icons
- `icon-md`: `h-5 w-5` (20px) - Card icons
- `icon-lg`: `h-6 w-6` (24px) - Header icons
- `icon-xl`: `h-8 w-8` (32px) - Hero icons

## Styling Guidelines

### DO's ✅

1. **Use semantic color tokens**:
   ```tsx
   <div className="bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
   ```

2. **Use semantic typography tokens**:
   ```tsx
   <h1 className="text-heading-1">Title</h1>
   <p className="text-body">Paragraph</p>
   ```

3. **Use icon size classes**:
   ```tsx
   <CheckIcon className="icon-sm" />
   ```

4. **Use animation tokens**:
   ```tsx
   <div className="transition-colors duration-200">
   ```

5. **Extend variants with `cva()`**:
   ```typescript
   const myVariants = cva("base-classes", {
     variants: { size: { sm: "...", lg: "..." } }
   });
   ```

### DON'Ts ❌

1. **Hardcode Tailwind colors**:
   ```tsx
   ❌ <div className="bg-teal-600 text-white">
   ✅ <div className="bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
   ```

2. **Use raw typography utilities**:
   ```tsx
   ❌ <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold leading-tight">
   ✅ <h1 className="text-heading-1">
   ```

3. **Use `transition-all`**:
   ```tsx
   ❌ <div className="transition-all duration-300">
   ✅ <div className="transition-colors duration-200">
   ```

4. **Override shadcn component internals**:
   ```tsx
   ❌ <Button className="bg-red-500 text-white"> // Bypasses variant system
   ✅ <Button variant="destructive"> // Uses proper variant
   ```

5. **Use hardcoded icon sizes**:
   ```tsx
   ❌ <CheckIcon className="h-5 w-5" />
   ✅ <CheckIcon className="icon-md" />
   ```

## Migration Patterns

### Pattern 1: Button Migration

**Before**:
```tsx
<button 
  onClick={handleClick}
  className="bg-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-700 text-white font-bold py-2 px-4 rounded"
>
  Submit
</button>
```

**After**:
```tsx
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

<Button onClick={handleClick}>
  Submit
</Button>
```

**Preserved Logic**:
- ✅ `onClick` handler
- ✅ Button text content
- ✅ Implicit focus/hover states (shadcn handles this)

---

### Pattern 2: Card Migration

**Before**:
```tsx
<div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg shadow-md p-6 border border-slate-200">
  <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2">Title</h3>
  <p className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 text-sm mb-4">Description</p>
  <div className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Content</div>
  <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end">
    <button className="bg-teal-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded">Action</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

**After**:
```tsx
import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle>Title</CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>Description</CardDescription>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent>Content</CardContent>
  <CardFooter className="justify-end">
    <Button>Action</Button>
  </CardFooter>
</Card>
```

**Preserved Logic**:
- ✅ Dark mode support (automatic via CSS variables)
- ✅ Layout structure
- ✅ Content hierarchy

---

### Pattern 3: Form Input Migration

**Before**:
```tsx
<div className="mb-4">
  <label htmlFor="email" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-2">
    Email
  </label>
  <input
    type="email"
    id="email"
    value={email}
    onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
    className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-slate-300 rounded-md focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-600"
    placeholder="Enter your email"
  />
  {error && <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{error}</p>}
</div>
```

**After**:
```tsx
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

<div className="grid w-full gap-1.5">
  <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
  <Input
    type="email"
    id="email"
    value={email}
    onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
    placeholder="Enter your email"
    className={error ? "border-destructive" : ""}
  />
  {error && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}
</div>
```

**Preserved Logic**:
- ✅ `value` and `onChange` props (controlled input)
- ✅ `placeholder` attribute
- ✅ Error display logic
- ✅ Label association (`htmlFor`)

## Third-Party Library Exceptions

Some libraries cannot be migrated to shadcn/ui (see `exceptions.json`):

### React Select

**Justification**: Multi-select, async search, custom rendering not supported by shadcn Select

**Workaround**: Wrap with semantic color classes
```tsx
import ReactSelect from "react-select";

<div className="[&_.react-select__control]:bg-card [&_.react-select__control]:border-border">
  <ReactSelect options={options} />
</div>
```

---

## Testing Requirements

### Visual Regression Testing

Every migrated component must have Storybook stories:

```tsx
// src/components/ui/button.stories.tsx
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react";
import { Button } from "./button";

const meta: Meta<typeof Button> = {
  title: "UI/Button",
  component: Button,
  tags: ["autodocs"],
};

export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof Button>;

export const Primary: Story = {
  args: { children: "Button", variant: "default" },
};

export const Destructive: Story = {
  args: { children: "Delete", variant: "destructive" },
};

// ... all variants
```

### Accessibility Testing

Every component must pass:
1. **axe-core**: Automated a11y tests in Storybook
2. **Lighthouse**: 100/100 accessibility score
3. **Screen Reader**: Manual testing with NVDA/JAWS
